Metadata.description: Invoice checks with a human approval gate.

NotFound.title: Not found
NotFound.text: This page or invoice does not exist.

Login.intro: Log in with a seeded reviewer or approver account. There is no sign-up.

DemoCredentials.label: Demo login
DemoCredentials.title: Public demo accounts
DemoCredentials.note: A blocked invoice needs both: the reviewer requests an override, the approver confirms it. Here one visitor can use both accounts, so the demo shows the mechanism, not a real separation of duties. Made-up sample invoices, reset every night. Do not upload real data.

Queue.title: Invoice queue
Queue.pageInfo: Page {page} of {pages} · {total, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
Queue.shortcutsHint: Keys: j / k to move, Enter to open, ? for help

Invoice.llmCalls: {count, plural, one {# LLM call} other {# LLM calls}}, ${cost}
Invoice.lowConfidence: {count, plural, one {# field with low confidence is highlighted} other {# fields with low confidence are highlighted}}: compare them with the original.
Invoice.shortcutsHint: Keys: a approve, r reject, Esc back, ? help

Document.pdfFailed: The PDF cannot be shown here; download the original.
Document.notLocated: {field}: not located in the PDF text layer. Compare it with the page by eye.
Document.xrechnungTitle: E-invoice in the KoSIT XRechnung visualization

Fields.llmLow: LLM {confidence} – low confidence, check the PDF

Decision.noDecision: No decision possible while the invoice is {status}.
Decision.reopenIntro: Rejected by mistake? Reopen it: the checks run again on the current master data, and it waits for review.
Decision.noSuggestion: No suggestion: no booked line to compare with.
Decision.suggested: Suggested {account} {name} ({share} %, {method, select, vector {by meaning} other {by text match}}) from {sources}.
Decision.blockedBy: Blocked by failed checks: {checks}. Approving it needs an override: your reason, then a confirmation by a second person with the approver role.
Decision.confirmChecked: I checked the failed checks and ask to approve anyway.
Decision.overrideRequested: Override requested by {requester} for the failed checks: {checks}. It waits for a second person with the approver role.
Decision.blockerRole: Only a user with the approver role can confirm or decline it.
Decision.blockerRequester: You requested it, so a different approver has to decide it.

Investigation.intro: The agent reads the ERP and the supplier registry (read only) and proposes an explanation and an email. It cannot approve or change the invoice.
Investigation.steps: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}}: model calls and tool calls
Investigation.emailTitle: Email draft to the supplier (German, not sent)
Investigation.metaRecorded: {status} · recorded run from {date} (no model on this server) · {model} · {input}/{output} tokens · {cost} · {duration}

Export.exported: Exported {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} to DATEV.
Export.withoutTaxKey: {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} without a tax key (several or unknown VAT rates): set the tax in DATEV.
Export.withoutAccountSplit: {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} as one row (lines do not add up to the totals, for example a document discount): split by account in DATEV.
Export.remaining: {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} from a later fiscal year still waiting: export again.

Upload.title: Upload an invoice
Upload.intro: An XRechnung XML (UBL or CII) or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF with embedded XML, up to 10 MB. The invoice is checked right after the upload and then waits in the queue for review.
Upload.demoNote: Public demo: PDFs without embedded XML are refused, because no model runs on visitors’ files. Uploads are limited per hour, and every invoice uploaded here is deleted by the nightly reset.
Upload.slow: Uploaded. Processing takes longer than usual; the invoice page shows the result.

summary.ready: All checks passed. The invoice is ready for review.
summary.blocked: At least one check failed. The invoice is blocked and waits for review.
summary.awaitingExtraction: The PDF has no embedded XML and waits for LLM extraction.
summary.failed: The invoice could not be read. It is in the queue with the reason.

problems.wrongType: Choose an XRechnung XML file or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (.xml or .pdf).
problems.tooLarge: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
problems.unreadable: The upload could not be read.
problems.noInvoice: The API did not return the new invoice.
problems.session: Your session has ended. Log in again.
problems.unsupported: Upload an XML or PDF invoice; the file extension must match its content.
problems.tooMany: Too many uploads. Try again later.

Security.title: Security events
Security.forbidden: Only users with the approver role can read the security events.
Security.introAll: Failed logins, lockouts, refused role checks, self-approval attempts and prompt injections found in invoices. Newest first. Read-only: the log cannot be changed.
Security.introLatest: Failed logins, lockouts, refused role checks, self-approval attempts and prompt injections found in invoices. Newest first, the latest {shown} of {total}. Read-only: the log cannot be changed.

describe.loginRateLimited: Too many failed logins from one address: {email}
describe.selfApproval: Tried to decide their own override request ({action})
describe.injection: Prompt injection suspected in the invoice text: {rules}

Errors.noSession: The API did not start a session.
Errors.reasonAndAccounts: Enter a reason and choose an account for every line.
Errors.confirmChecked: Confirm that you checked the failed checks.

reason.awaiting_extraction: The PDF has no embedded e-invoice XML; it needs LLM extraction.
reason.extraction_off: The PDF has no embedded e-invoice XML, and LLM extraction is skipped: no API key is configured (INVOICEGUARD_LLM_API_KEY).
reason.daily_budget: The daily LLM budget (INVOICEGUARD_LLM_DAILY_BUDGET_USD) is used up; the PDF is extracted after the next API restart on a later day.
reason.internal_error: Processing failed with an internal error; see the API logs.
reason.restarted: Reset after an API restart interrupted processing.
